items.docs: Create an upload session that allows an app to iteratively upload ranges of a file, so as to attach the file to the specified Outlook item. The item can be a message or event. Use this approach to attach a file if the file size is between 3 MB and 150 MB. info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action cancel

items.docs:
This action allows the organizer of a meeting to send a cancellation message and cancel the event.  The action moves the event to the Deleted Items folder. The organizer can also cancel an occurrence of a recurring meeting 
by providing the occurrence event ID. An attendee calling this action gets an error (HTTP 400 Bad Request), with the following
error message: 'Your request can't be completed. You need to be an organizer to cancel a meeting.' This action differs from Delete in that Cancel i

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action decline

items.docs: Decline invitation to the specified event in a user calendar. If the event allows proposals for new times, on declining the event, an invitee can choose to suggest an alternative time by including the proposedNewTime parameter. For more information on how to propose a time, and how to receive and accept a new time proposal, see Propose new meeting times.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action dismissReminder

items.docs: Dismiss a reminder that has been triggered for an event in a user calendar.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action forward

items.docs:
This action allows the organizer or attendee of a meeting event to forward the
meeting request to a new recipient. If the meeting event is forwarded from an attendee's Microsoft 365 mailbox to another recipient, this action
also sends a message to notify the organizer of the forwarding, and adds the recipient to the organizer's
copy of the meeting event. This convenience is not available when forwarding from an Outlook.com account.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action snoozeReminder

items.docs: Postpone a reminder for an event in a user calendar until a new time.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Invoke action tentativelyAccept

items.docs: Tentatively accept the specified event in a user calendar. If the event allows proposals for new times, on responding tentative to the event, an invitee can choose to suggest an alternative time by including the proposedNewTime parameter. For more information on how to propose a time, and how to receive and accept a new time proposal, see Propose new meeting times.
